notes.title: Update 1.4.2
notes.notes: [p]Hello there, I'm back after a longer break, lately I had to take care of my two other projects (original 2D Leaden Sky and Final Response) and update them, but I did not forget about Leaden Sky: Nightmares, this time I bring you update 1.4.2 which introduces plenty quality improvements and new playable section![/p][p]Originally I wanted to include Chapter 2 here but unfortunatelly I just ran out of time and wasn't able to finish it before release of this update, but it will appear soon in the Update 1.5 planned for next month.[/p][p][/p][p]Update 1.4.2 changes, improvements and additions:[/p][p]- new playable level in the "Prison of Thoughts" (last section in Chapter 1 nightmare)[/p][p]- extended level in Chapter 1 nightmare (new environments, more encounters)[/p][p]- higher FPS stability and performance[/p][p]- improved weapon accuracy, more realistic recoil scale for each wewapon[/p][p]- rebalanced AI speed, accuracy, damage and health[/p][p]- properly balanced difficulty modes[/p][p]- more realistic, natural aiming added for enemy AI instead of locking on the player[/p][p]- minor fixes to various textures and visual details in game[/p][p]- post processing fixes, wider color range and more natural brightness and contrast[/p][p]- improved anti-aliasing shader (FXAA (2), optional)[/p][p]- changed gamepad controls to resemble standarized layout[/p][p]- progress bar and background image for loading screens[/p][p]- much faster checkpoint reloading[/p][p]- options added to title screen[/p][p]- added fall damage[/p][p]- smooth filtering of rendered image[/p][p]- improved ragdoll physics[/p][p]- realistic jumping physics[/p][p]- added subtle red HUD blink for low health, low ammo and low stamina[/p][p]- HUD texture fixes[/p][p]- rebalanced flashlight brigthness[/p][p]- rebalanced environment lighting[/p][p]- various fixes and improvements to decals[/p][p]- improved frame pacing (with V-sync on)[/p][p]- dynamic resolution (works in case of FPS drops)[/p][p]- adjusted ammo capacity for all weapons to be more accurate and realisc[/p][p]- realistic round chambering after reloading firearms (magazine size +1 in chamber)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44833360/51cedd0a670b39b12829654413c6a474e9518274.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Update 1.5 is planned for the next month (September 2025, though exact release date can vary) and it will include Chapter 2 this time. [/p][p]Have fun and let me know how you liked this update, if you encountered any issues let me know in the comment section, I will do my best to fix those right away![/p]

notes.title: Update 1.4.1
notes.notes:
Update 1.4.1

This update improves technical aspects of the game and fixes some minor issues:

- reduced shader stuttering for a much smoother experience
- added full controller support with hints
- much better optimization in power plant combat sections
- fixes to lighting 
- chapter selection menu added
- option to skip cutscenes on a second playthrough of each chapter
- fixes to menus
- fixes to text

notes.title: Update 1.4
notes.notes:
Hello there, developer here, it's been a long time since the last update but it's finally here!
A lot of the things have changed in the game, there is a large amount of improvements and additions, here are some of them:

- a completely new, playable chapter have been added to the game (Introduction)
- chapter 1 has been nearly completely remade 
- much more story elements, improved cutscene art, added voice acting
- added new note system 
- graphical options
- controller support
- complete graphics remake, almost every single texture and a lot of the models have been completely remade to a higher quality
- the gunplay will now feel heavier, more impactful and more satisfying
- more responsive controls
- rebalanced gameplay
- remade all menus
- added much more ambient music
- added 2 new enemy types, beahaviour of previous enemy types has been improved aswell
- added 2 new weapons (explore and you will find them)
- much better pacing for the storyline and gameplay
- improved animations
- improved sound effects and particle effects
- improved lighting system, now with fully dynamic lighting and advanced shaders

And much more, play the update and see for yourself!

notes.notes:
Hello there, I'm back! Sorry for not posting anything for so long, I was entirely focused on creating a huge update for this game. Today I want to show you a teaser video showcasing a small part of upcoming update, I've remade nearly entire game and improved it's graphics, artstyle, storytelling, gameplay mechanics, sound design, animation, nearly all the levels were also remade for better and smoother experience, not to mention the menus, controls, new enemy types, new weapons etc. I know that you have waited 7 months for this update, but trust me it was absolutely worth it!

notes.title: Update 1.4 - Work in progress
notes.notes:
Hello there, it's been a while since I've posted here, but that's because I was very busy with upcoming update. There is a huge overhaul coming soon, I aim to improve the combat, pacing, level design, animations, visuals, AI, sounds and even menus, basically every part of the game.

So, I bit about the upcoming update:

Chapter 1:
There are some large changes to first chapter of the game, previously the forest levels dragged on for a bit too long, but this has been addressed now and those sections are now shorter, tighter packed and easier to navigate around. The rest of the chapter however has been replaced with completely new levels which will provide better storytelling and better combat, I'm still working on it so for now all I can say is that you will visit mental asylum which is largely imporatnt for backstory of a newly introduced character, it's strictly connected to power plant anomalies and origins of the story. Remaining levels of Chapter 1 will touch on the backstory of main character - Kyle in brand new levels with highly nightmarish abstraction (in a good sense).

Chapter 2 (part 1):
Since I've done a lot of work on remaking and improving a lot of existing aspects of the game, I can only release half of Chapter 2 for upcoming 1.4, but don't worry, the second half will come not long after that.
The first half of Chapter 2 will start with some massive horror action which will include some really dynamic encounters with monsters, anomalies and even human enemies, it will take place both in nightmares and in reality (in the game world sense) so prepare for a brand new experience. The theme and general direction of this chapter will be heavily industrial with a high dose of abstraction and artistic representations of the storms near power plant.

So this was the general overview of what you can expect in future posts and in update 1.4 once it comes out. On top of that I've done a lot of additions and improvements to the game mechanics, such as polishing the leaning mechanics, adding ADS reloads, remaking weapon animations, adding better procedural recoil, adding two new weapons (heavy pistol and grenade), adding human enemy types, adding graphical options to menus etc. I will give you a full list in next update post, for now enjoy this small combat showcase, I hope you like how the game plays now (WORK IN PROGRESS):

[previewyoutube=4-kcvJtntwo;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]

I can't give the exact release date but I hold my best hopes to release Update 1.4 this month.

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS Update (1.3.2)
notes.notes:
Hello again, I've managed to finally release the 1.3.2 update for Leaden Sky: Nightmares.
It's been a lot of work but now I can finally start developing Chapter 2 which all of you have been waiting for. The update is big and contains a lot of improvements for the game, here goes the list:

- environments have significantly more details now 
- added ambient occlusion
- rebalanced color palette
- quick knife melee attack added
- added another enemy type
- added basic controls tutorial at the start of the game
- cutscene pictures have been improved in terms of quality and detail
- increased rendering resolution
- increased rendering distance
- improved materials and textures
- improved post-processing
- lonely road has been remade into something much more abstract and interesting
- gardens level is more open now and doesn't force backtracking
- added "Prison of Thoughts" and more references to the original Leaden Sky
- added level transition screens with storytelling elements
- added more sound cues to enemies
- remade HUD
- rebalanced combat
- rebalanced AI
- difficulty modes
- more combat
- new ambient tracks and new music in general
- glowing sights added to SMG and shotgun
- improved blood decals
- enemy heads now explode from gunfire
- wound decals on enemies
- ragdoll physics for one of the enemy types
- dry branches which crack under npcs and players feet
- added tactical leaning left and right

notes.title: Quick Fix! (1.3.1) Update
notes.notes:
Welcome again, It's me - Łukasz, developer of the game.

Few days after EARLY ACCESS release I got some feedback regarding the game and did my best to improve it. Improvements to chapter 1 will come in "QUICK FIX" updates to the 1.3 version aimed to get rid of bugs, add more combat and polish the game before moving on to chapter 2 development.  

First version of "QUICK FIX" updates just been released, I plan to do 2 of those or more if necessary, I already have plans for 1.3.2 aswell which will be developed in upcoming week.



QUICK FIX - 1.3.1

- much more combat is added, now the game feels a lot less like walking simulator and more like proper horror shooter

- added new enemy type: Fallen, they are electrocuting type of enemy which require firearms to fight and helps balance the game

- reduced ammo pickups per item, but more items overall added

- fixes to AI pathfinding issues

- automatic shotgun added to the game (Benelli M4)

- firearms are now easier to find

- new introduction screen for the story

- improved title screen and colors added to cutscenes

- different sound for gunshots indoors and outdoors

- improved gore textures

- increased healing from 30 to roughly 40% per item

- UI fixes, dynamic crosshair added

- flashlight flickering when near electrical anomalies



Planned for next update (1.3.2):

- adding another enemy type

- adding more detail to environments

- lonely road will get a whole new underground section

- checkpoint system

- overhaul of the aluminium factory level

- notes system with more story and lore



Let me know if you have any questions of suggestions regarding the game, I'm always happy to engage in constructive discussion with my community.

I'll be taking your feedback into account when making future progress so you are very welcomed in the comment section below.

notes.title: Leaden Sky: Nightmares - version 1.3 Update
notes.notes:
Hello there, recently I have decided to do a complete graphics overhaul for Leaden Sky: Nightmares in order to bring it closer to the original artstyle the Leaden Sky 2022 Demo (2D) had.

Improvements include:

- lots of remade textures, often twice the size of original, this includes environments, player models and enemies

- new materials with irregular surfaces and reflective properties

- great fixes to lighting system and implementation of new dynamic shadows

- post processing fixes

- fixes to UV

- modern splatmap for terrain

- fixes to meshes normals

- added much better lighting for double sided surfaces

- increased rendering resolution

- controls list is now included in pause menu

- small fixes to opening cutscene
